title: TACTICAL BELT AND GUN LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD with one word for each thing, and a place on the tactical belt is a slot. The belt lines said ON KEY 9, a gun taken from the backpack said one long sentence with a semicolon (Scav Pistol is yours; it goes back to the armoury. Shotgun equipped), and the throwable, roll and jam lines were still sentences. Belt lines now read MEDKIT TO SLOT 9 and MEDKIT OFF SLOT 9, a non-gun on a gun slot reads SLOT 1 TAKES GUNS ONLY, a gun taken reads SHOTGUN EQUIPPED with what happened to the old one as the detail, issued kit is issued gear, a gun put away is a pickup row tagged BACKPACK, and TOO TIRED TO ROLL, NO THROWABLES LEFT, FRAG CHARGE READY, NO FRAG CHARGE LEFT with the gun key as the detail, JAM CLEARED and THROW THE ONE IN YOUR HAND FIRST are caps callouts. The Undercroft floor belt is unchanged.
now: Tactical belt and gun lines read as caps callouts with the slot word, such as MEDKIT TO SLOT 9 and SHOTGUN EQUIPPED.
